item.title: On Religion: Will the Vatican embrace St. Thea of Mississippi?
item.description: In the final months of her life, Sister Thea Bowman heard the whispers. She appreciated the hugs that lingered longer, as believers promised to keep praying that she would win her battle with cancer. She saw the warm glances, tinged with awe, as Catholics -- especially Black Catholics -- quietly discussed whether Rome would someday recognize her as St. Thea of Mississippi.
